# Sanitized Hallmark format fixture

`library.json` is invented data in the format read from Hallmark commit `15ee84d9de5385658b8d9dff1408728fb9e28fbd` (`src/library/portable.rs`; format `hallmark-library`, version 1, path/content entries). It is not exported operational history. Its accepted frontmatter, unknown key and script-looking body verify that provenance survives while external approval/instructions stay untrusted and inert.
